+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.Sandwich.Support
+
+/-!
+# Completion on a prescribed set of outcomes
+
+This formalization-only auxiliary constructs a complete measurement supported on
+the good outcomes of a finite measurement, by sending every bad outcome to a
+specified good outcome. For projective measurements this adds the complementary
+projection to the default effect and preserves projectivity. The consistency
+estimates charge changes of outcome labels only to the state mass of that
+complementary projection, on either of two possibly different player spaces.
+
+The source-specific estimate on the mass outside the image of the polynomial
+combining map is the unimplemented target `global_polynomial_bad_mass_le`,
+specified in `audits/2026-09-06_supported-projective-completion.md` under issue #279.
+No result here asserts the global polynomial-pair theorem or derives that estimate.
+
+## References
+
+* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1364-1402`,
+  the completion step after `eq:qld-sgg-mhat-sandwich` in `lem:qld-4-7`.
+* Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`, whose source theorem remains separate from this auxiliary.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.SupportedCompletion
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT hiding Measurement
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum
+open DistanceCalculus
+
+variable {α β X ι ιA ιB : Type*}
+variable [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
+variable [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
+variable [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
+variable [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
+
+/-- Retain every good outcome and send every other outcome to the specified
+good outcome. The default is actual domain data, with its membership proof. -/
+def toGood (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (a : α) : {a // good a} :=
+  if h : good a then ⟨a, h⟩ else a₀
+
+omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
+@[simp] theorem toGood_coe (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ a : {a // good a}) : toGood good a₀ a = a := by
+  simp [toGood, a.property]
+
+/-- The omitted effects. When the measurement is projective, their sum is the
+projection complementary to the sum of good effects. -/
+noncomputable def badEffect (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : Op ι :=
+  ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), M.effect a
+
+/-- Complete the restriction to good outcomes by adding all bad effects to
+`a₀`. This is an outcome postprocessing of the original complete measurement. -/
+noncomputable def complete (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a₀ : {a // good a}) :
+    Measurement {a // good a} ι :=
+  M.postprocess (toGood good a₀)
+
+/-- The completion is projective whenever the original measurement is
+projective, by projectivity of outcome postprocessing. -/
+theorem complete_isProjective (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (hM : Measurement.IsProjective M) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) : Measurement.IsProjective (complete M good a₀) :=
+  SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective M hM (toGood good a₀)
+
+omit [DecidableEq α] in
+/-- The bad effect is precisely the complement of the restricted total. -/
+theorem badEffect_eq_one_sub (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] :
+    badEffect M good = 1 - ∑ a : {a // good a}, M.effect a := by
+  have hsplit := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype good M.effect
+  have hbad : badEffect M good = ∑ a : {a // ¬ good a}, M.effect a := by
+    exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) M.effect
+  rw [hbad]
+  rw [M.sum_eq_one] at hsplit
+  exact eq_sub_of_add_eq' hsplit
+
+omit [DecidableEq α] in
+/-- The sum of the omitted effects is positive semidefinite. -/
+theorem badEffect_nonneg (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : 0 ≤ badEffect M good :=
+  Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => M.pos a
+
+/-- The submeasurement obtained by retaining only the good outcomes. -/
+noncomputable def restrict (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : Submeasurement {a // good a} ι where
+  effect a := M.effect a
+  pos a := M.pos a
+  sum_le_one := by
+    have h := badEffect_nonneg M good
+    rw [badEffect_eq_one_sub] at h
+    exact sub_nonneg.mp h
+
+/-- The bad effect is itself a projection: it is one effect of the binary
+postprocessing recording whether an outcome is bad. -/
+theorem badEffect_isStarProjection (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (hM : Measurement.IsProjective M) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] :
+    IsStarProjection (badEffect M good) := by
+  have h := SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective M hM
+    (fun a => decide (¬ good a)) true
+  change IsStarProjection (∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter
+    (fun a => decide (¬ good a) = true), M.effect a) at h
+  simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq, badEffect] using h
+
+/-- The completed default effect absorbs exactly the omitted projection;
+all other good effects are retained. -/
+theorem complete_effect (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a₀ a : {a // good a}) :
+    (complete M good a₀).effect a =
+      M.effect a + if a = a₀ then badEffect M good else 0 := by
+  classical
+  rw [complete, Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
+  have hterm (b : α) :
+      (if toGood good a₀ b = a then M.effect b else 0) =
+        (if b = a.val then M.effect b else 0) +
+          if a = a₀ then (if ¬ good b then M.effect b else 0) else 0 := by
+    by_cases hb : good b
+    · have heq : toGood good a₀ b = a ↔ b = a.val := by
+        simp [toGood, hb, Subtype.ext_iff]
+      simp [heq, hb]
+    · have hba : b ≠ a.val := by
+        rintro rfl
+        exact hb a.property
+      simp [toGood, hb, hba, eq_comm]
+  simp_rw [hterm]
+  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
+  simp [badEffect, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_ite_irrel]
+
+/-- Relabeling the completed measurement adds the bad effect to exactly the
+label of the chosen default outcome, relative to the relabeled restriction. -/
+theorem complete_postprocess_effect (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a₀ : {a // good a})
+    (g : {a // good a} → β) (b : β) :
+    ((complete M good a₀).postprocess g).effect b =
+      ((restrict M good).postprocess g).effect b +
+        if b = g a₀ then badEffect M good else 0 := by
+  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
+  simp_rw [complete_effect]
+  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
+  congr 1
+  simp [eq_comm]
+
+private theorem postprocess_overlap (M : Measurement α ι) (N : Measurement β ι)
+    (f : α → β) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
+    (∑ b, stateQForm ψ ((M.postprocess f).effect b * N.effect b)) =
+      ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * N.effect (f a)) := by
+  simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_mul,
+    stateQForm_finset_sum]
+  calc
+    (∑ b, ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
+        stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * N.effect b)) =
+      ∑ b, ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
+        stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * N.effect (f a)) := by
+          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+          intro b _
+          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+          intro a ha
+          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
+    _ = _ := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f _
+
+private theorem postprocess_defect (μ : Distribution X) (M : Measurement α ι)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ι) (f : X → α → β) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
+    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => (M.postprocess (f x)).effect a)
+        (fun x a => (N x).effect a) ψ =
+      avgOver μ (fun x => ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
+        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * (N x).effect (f x a))) := by
+  unfold consistencyDefect
+  simp_rw [consistency_term_eq_stateQForm, point_defect_eq, postprocess_overlap]
+
+private theorem leftPlaced_postprocess (M : Measurement α ιA) (f : α → β) :
+    leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) (M.postprocess f) =
+      (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) M).postprocess f := by
+  apply MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
+  intro b
+  exact heteroKron_finset_sum_left _ _ _
+
+private theorem rightPlaced_postprocess (M : Measurement α ιB) (f : α → β) :
+    rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := ιA) (M.postprocess f) =
+      (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := ιA) M).postprocess f := by
+  apply MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ext
+  intro b
+  exact heteroKron_finset_sum_right _ _ _
+
+private theorem left_postprocess_defect (μ : Distribution X) (M : Measurement α ιA)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (f : X → α → β)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => heteroKron ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ =
+      avgOver μ (fun x => ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
+        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (M.effect a) ((N x).effect (f x a)))) := by
+  change consistencyDefect μ
+    (fun x a => (leftPlacedMeasurement (M.postprocess (f x))).effect a)
+    (fun x a => (rightPlacedMeasurement (N x)).effect a) ψ = _
+  simp_rw [leftPlaced_postprocess]
+  rw [postprocess_defect]
+  simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
+    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne, placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
+
+private theorem right_postprocess_defect (μ : Distribution X) (M : Measurement α ιB)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (f : X → α → β)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ =
+      avgOver μ (fun x => ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
+        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (heteroKron ((N x).effect (f x a)) (M.effect a))) := by
+  change consistencyDefect μ
+    (fun x a => (rightPlacedMeasurement (M.postprocess (f x))).effect a)
+    (fun x a => (leftPlacedMeasurement (N x)).effect a) ψ = _
+  simp_rw [rightPlaced_postprocess]
+  rw [postprocess_defect]
+  simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
+    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne, heteroKron_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
+
+omit [DecidableEq α] [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] in
+/-- Equal good-outcome contributions cancel; the remaining averaged change
+is bounded by the sum of the bad-outcome upper bounds. -/
+private theorem abs_avg_sum_change_le (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability)
+    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (u v : X → α → ℝ) (r : α → ℝ)
+    (hu : ∀ x a, 0 ≤ u x a ∧ u x a ≤ r a)
+    (hv : ∀ x a, 0 ≤ v x a ∧ v x a ≤ r a)
+    (huv : ∀ x a, good a → u x a = v x a) (c : ℝ) :
+    |avgOver μ (fun x => c - ∑ a, u x a) -
+        avgOver μ (fun x => c - ∑ a, v x a)| ≤
+      ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), r a := by
+  have hpoint (x : X) :
+      |(c - ∑ a, u x a) - (c - ∑ a, v x a)| ≤
+        ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), r a := by
+    have hterm (a : α) : |v x a - u x a| ≤ if ¬ good a then r a else 0 := by
+      by_cases ha : good a
+      · simp [ha, huv x a ha]
+      · rw [if_pos ha]
+        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(hu x a).2, (hv x a).1],
+          by linarith [(hv x a).2, (hu x a).1]⟩
+    calc
+      _ = |∑ a, (v x a - u x a)| := by
+        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
+        congr 1
+        ring
+      _ ≤ ∑ a, |v x a - u x a| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
+      _ ≤ ∑ a, if ¬ good a then r a else 0 :=
+        Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => hterm a
+      _ = _ := (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm
+  rw [← avgOver_sub]
+  calc
+    _ ≤ avgOver μ (fun x => |(c - ∑ a, u x a) - (c - ∑ a, v x a)|) := by
+      unfold avgOver
+      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans_eq ?_
+      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+      intro x _
+      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (μ.nonnegative x)]
+    _ ≤ avgOver μ (fun _ =>
+        ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), r a) :=
+      avgOver_mono μ _ _ hpoint
+    _ = _ := avgOver_const_of_isProbability μ hμ _
+
+/-- Relabelings that agree on good outcomes change Alice-first cross-player
+consistency by at most Alice's bad-outcome state mass. The spaces may differ,
+the other measurement need not be projective, and the state may be unnormalized.
+This auxiliary isolates the quantitative content of the source completion step. -/
+theorem abs_postprocess_consistency_left_sub_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιA)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (f g : X → α → β) (hfg : ∀ x a, good a → f x a = g x a)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    |consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ -
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((M.postprocess (g x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ| ≤
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (badEffect M good) (1 : Op ιB)) := by
+  rw [left_postprocess_defect, left_postprocess_defect]
+  simp only [badEffect, heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum]
+  have hbound (x : X) (a : α) (b : β) :
+      0 ≤ stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (M.effect a) ((N x).effect b)) ∧
+        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (M.effect a) ((N x).effect b)) ≤
+          stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (M.effect a) (1 : Op ιB)) :=
+    ⟨stateQForm_nonneg ψ (kronecker_nonneg (M.pos a) ((N x).pos b)),
+      quadratic_form_mono
+        (kronecker_le_kronecker_right_one (M.pos a) (measurement_effect_le_one (N x) b)) ψ⟩
+  exact abs_avg_sum_change_le μ hμ good _ _ _
+    (fun x a => hbound x a (f x a)) (fun x a => hbound x a (g x a))
+    (fun x a ha => by rw [hfg x a ha]) _
+
+/-- Relabelings that agree on good outcomes change Bob-first cross-player
+consistency by at most Bob's bad-outcome state mass. The completed measurement
+is the first consistency argument, although it acts on the right tensor factor;
+this is the orientation of the Bob conclusion of `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
+theorem abs_postprocess_consistency_right_sub_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιB)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (f g : X → α → β) (hfg : ∀ x a, good a → f x a = g x a)
+    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    |consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ -
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (g x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ| ≤
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (badEffect M good)) := by
+  rw [right_postprocess_defect, right_postprocess_defect]
+  simp only [badEffect, heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum]
+  have hbound (x : X) (a : α) (b : β) :
+      0 ≤ stateQForm ψ (heteroKron ((N x).effect b) (M.effect a)) ∧
+        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron ((N x).effect b) (M.effect a)) ≤
+          stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (M.effect a)) :=
+    ⟨stateQForm_nonneg ψ (kronecker_nonneg ((N x).pos b) (M.pos a)),
+      quadratic_form_mono
+        (kronecker_mono_left (measurement_effect_le_one (N x) b) (M.pos a)) ψ⟩
+  exact abs_avg_sum_change_le μ hμ good _ _ _
+    (fun x a => hbound x a (f x a)) (fun x a => hbound x a (g x a))
+    (fun x a ha => by rw [hfg x a ha]) _
+
+/-- After any outcome maps agreeing on the good outcomes, the constructed
+completion changes Alice-first consistency by at most the bad projection's
+state mass. Together with `complete_isProjective`, this is the finite-measurement
+adapter for the completion step of `lem:qld-4-7`, not its source mass estimate. -/
+theorem abs_complete_consistency_left_sub_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιA)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (f : X → α → β) (g : X → {a // good a} → β)
+    (hgf : ∀ x a, g x a = f x a) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    |consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron (((complete M good a₀).postprocess (g x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ -
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a) 1)
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect a)) ψ| ≤
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (badEffect M good) (1 : Op ιB)) := by
+  simp only [complete, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_comp]
+  apply abs_postprocess_consistency_left_sub_le μ hμ M N good _ f _ ψ
+  intro x a ha
+  simpa only [toGood, dif_pos ha] using hgf x ⟨a, ha⟩
+
+/-- The same completion estimate with the completed measurement on Bob's
+space, still as the first argument of consistency. Both player spaces and the
+order of the tensor factors remain explicit. -/
+theorem abs_complete_consistency_right_sub_le
+    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιB)
+    (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
+    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (f : X → α → β) (g : X → {a // good a} → β)
+    (hgf : ∀ x a, g x a = f x a) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
+    |consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (((complete M good a₀).postprocess (g x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ -
+      consistencyDefect μ
+        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a))
+        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ| ≤
+      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (badEffect M good)) := by
+  simp only [complete, MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_comp]
+  apply abs_postprocess_consistency_right_sub_le μ hμ M N good _ f _ ψ
+  intro x a ha
+  simpa only [toGood, dif_pos ha] using hgf x ⟨a, ha⟩
+
+/-- Adding one fixed operator at a question-dependent outcome changes the
+defect by its total state mass minus the overlap at that outcome. -/
+private theorem add_at_outcome_defect (μ : Distribution X)

+    simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.DistanceTheorems.Support
+
+/-!
+# Finite controlled unitaries
+
+A complete projective measurement controls a family of operators on a second
+finite-dimensional space. Orthogonality of the measurement effects makes
+multiplication of the resulting operator sums componentwise. In particular,
+unitary components give a unitary controlled operator.
+
+These are formalization-only algebraic lemmas, not the extraction theorem:
+they do not construct the global measurement or establish the Pauli relations.
+
+## References
+
+- `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`,
+  the unitarity calculation in the proof of `lem:qld-unitary`.
+- Blueprint `def:v-swap-unitary` and `lem:v-swap-conjugation`.
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators Matrix
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.Quantum
+
+open MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+variable {Outcome Control Target : Type*}
+variable [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype Control] [DecidableEq Control]
+variable [Fintype Target]
+
+/-- Multiplication of operator sums controlled by the same projective measurement
+is componentwise. This isolates the orthogonality calculation in the proof of
+`lem:qld-unitary`, before any unitarity of the controlled components is used. -/
+theorem sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron
+    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
+    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
+    (leftOperators rightOperators : Outcome → Op Target) :
+    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (leftOperators outcome)) *
+        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (rightOperators outcome)) =
+      ∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome)
+        (leftOperators outcome * rightOperators outcome) := by
+  classical
+  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
+  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, heteroKron_mul]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro outcome _
+  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single outcome]
+  · rw [(hprojective outcome).isIdempotentElem.eq]
+  · intro other _ hother
+    rw [DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero
+      measurement hprojective hother.symm]
+    exact Matrix.zero_kronecker _
+  · simp
+
+variable [DecidableEq Target]
+
+/-- A controlled operator times its adjoint is the identity when each component
+times its adjoint is the identity. This is the finite controlled-unitary
+calculation at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`,
+with arbitrary unitary components in place of the products of Pauli observables. -/
+theorem sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose
+    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
+    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
+    (operators : Outcome → Op Target)
+    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, operators outcome * (operators outcome)ᴴ = 1) :
+    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) *
+        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome))ᴴ = 1 := by
+  have hself (outcome : Outcome) :
+      (measurement.effect outcome)ᴴ = measurement.effect outcome :=
+    (hprojective outcome).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
+  calc
+    _ = (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) *
+        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) ((operators outcome)ᴴ)) := by
+      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum, heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker,
+        Matrix.conjTranspose_kronecker, hself]
+    _ = ∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome)
+        (operators outcome * (operators outcome)ᴴ) :=
+      sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron measurement hprojective _ _
+    _ = ∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (1 : Op Target) := by
+      simp_rw [hunitary]
+    _ = 1 := by
+      rw [← DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left, measurement.sum_eq_one,
+        heteroKron_one_one]
+
+/-- The reverse adjoint product of a controlled operator is also the identity.
+For finite square matrices, Mathlib's `mul_eq_one_comm` converts either inverse
+identity to the other, both for the components and for the controlled operator.
+This supplies the reverse identity implicit in the same source calculation. -/
+theorem conjTranspose_mul_sum_heteroKron
+    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
+    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
+    (operators : Outcome → Op Target)
+    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, (operators outcome)ᴴ * operators outcome = 1) :
+    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome))ᴴ *
+        (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) = 1 := by
+  apply mul_eq_one_comm.mp
+  apply sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose measurement hprojective operators
+  intro outcome
+  exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp (hunitary outcome)
+
+/-- A finite sum of unitary operators controlled by a complete projective
+measurement is unitary. The hypotheses concern the actual component operators;
+no unitarity or extraction conclusion is assumed for their controlled sum. -/
+theorem sum_heteroKron_mem_unitary
+    (measurement : Measurement Outcome Control)
+    (hprojective : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective measurement)
+    (operators : Outcome → Op Target)
+    (hunitary : ∀ outcome, operators outcome ∈ unitary (Op Target)) :
+    (∑ outcome, heteroKron (measurement.effect outcome) (operators outcome)) ∈
+      unitary (Op (Control × Target)) := by
+  exact ⟨conjTranspose_mul_sum_heteroKron measurement hprojective operators
+      (fun outcome => (hunitary outcome).1),
+    sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose measurement hprojective operators
+      (fun outcome => (hunitary outcome).2)⟩
+
+end MIPStarRE.Quantum

  1598	\begin{definition}[Directly indexed sub-line laws]
  1599		\label{def:direct-subline-law}
  1600		\lean{MIPStarRE.QPBT.SubLineWitness}
  1601		\leanok
  1602		\uses{def:ith-restricted-line, def:line-representative, def:combine-map}
  1603		Put $n=2m+2$. The directly indexed extended line-point law samples
  1604		$i\in\{0,\dots,n-1\}$ and $u,v\in\F_q^n$ independently and uniformly,
  1605		and chooses the axis or diagonal kind with equal probabilities.
  1606		For the axis kind set $w=e_i$; for the diagonal kind set $w_j=0$ for
  1607		$j<i$ and $w_j=v_j$ for $j\ge i$. The line has base $L_w^{\mathrm{lnf}}(u)$
  1608		and direction $w$, retaining its kind and coordinate index; the sampled
  1609		point is $u$. Zero diagonal directions are included.
  1610	
  1611		A directly indexed sub-line law $D_{\mathrm{dir}}$ is a probability law
  1612		on triples $(\ell,\ell_X,\ell_Z)$ with the following properties.
  1613		Its extended-line marginal is the line marginal just defined.
  1614		Every supported triple admits affine maps $t\mapsto a_W+b_Wt$ such that
  1615		\[
  1616			\pi_W(\ell(t))=\ell_W(a_W+b_Wt),\qquad W\in\{X,Z\},
  1617		\]
  1618		where $\ell(t)$ denotes base plus parameter times direction and the
  1619		field identifications are understood. Thus each extended point projects
  1620		onto its two source lines, with affine scalar coordinates $\alpha(t)$
  1621		and $\beta(t)$ as in Definition~\ref{def:combine-map}. An axis-parallel
  1622		extended line has axis-parallel source lines.
  1623	
  1624		Finally there is one probability law on
  1625		$(\mathrm v,i,j)\in\{\mathrm{ALine},\mathrm{DLine}\}
  1626		\times\{0,\dots,m-1\}^2$ with the following two mixture properties.
  1627		Sample a triple from $D_{\mathrm{dir}}$ and an independent uniform
  1628		parameter $t$ on $\ell$. The law of $(\ell_X,\ell_Z,\pi_X(\ell(t)))$
  1629		is the mixture obtained by sampling $(\ell_X,x)$ from
  1630		$D_{\mathrm v,i}$ and independently $\ell_Z$ from the line marginal of
  1631		$D_{\mathrm v,j}$, and retaining $(\ell_X,\ell_Z,x)$.
  1632		The law of $(\ell_X,\ell_Z,\pi_Z(\ell(t)))$ is the mixture obtained
  1633		by retaining $(\ell_X,\ell_Z,z)$ from the corresponding independent
  1634		samples of $\ell_X$ and $(\ell_Z,z)$. These are separate one-point
  1635		marginal identities, with the same mixture weights; they impose no
  1636		joint conditional independence of the two projected points.
  1637		Identification with the source law $D$ is a separate obligation;
  1638		see \cite{gap:qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility}.
  1639	\end{definition}

    69	        heteroKron ((setting.pauliMeas side basis).effect answers.1)

    88	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind)

    98	/-- Evaluating the reference polynomial is equivalent to evaluating the two Pauli

   101	theorem encodingPauliMeas_postprocess_eval (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
   102	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) (point : Fin params.m → PauliScalar params) :
   103	    (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).postprocess (fun poly => evalPoly poly point) =
   104	      (tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliEvalMeas side basis point)

   106	          (fun answer => lowDegreeEnc answer point))).postprocess

   110	    Measurement.postprocess_comp]
   111	  apply congrArg ((tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliMeas side basis)
   112	    (pauliRegisterMeas basis)).postprocess)

   121	theorem encodingPauliMeas_eval_effect_eq_convolution
   122	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind)
   123	    (point : Fin params.m → PauliScalar params) (value : PauliScalar params) :
   124	    ((setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).postprocess
   125	      (fun poly => evalPoly poly point)).effect value =
   126	      ∑ values ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   127	          (fun values : PauliScalar params × PauliScalar params => values.1 + values.2 = value),
   128	        heteroKron ((setting.pauliEvalMeas side basis point).effect values.1)
   129	          (tauPointProj basis point values.2) := by
   130	  rw [encodingPauliMeas_postprocess_eval, Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   131	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   132	  intro values _
   133	  change heteroKron ((setting.pauliEvalMeas side basis point).effect values.1)
   134	    (((pauliRegisterMeas basis).postprocess
   135	      (fun answer => lowDegreeEnc answer point)).effect values.2) = _
   136	  simp only [Measurement.postprocess_effect, lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct]
   137	  rfl

     4	/-!
     5	# Projective rounding through outcome postprocessing
     6	
     7	Consistent complete POVMs on two possibly different local spaces have projective
     8	roundings on those same spaces. Their consistency with an opposite-player POVM
     9	survives every question-dependent outcome map, with error
    10	`δ + sqrt (220 * δ^(1/4)) + 2 * sqrt (δ + η)` when the original consistency errors
    11	are at most `δ` and `η`. The estimate is independent of both local dimensions and
    12	the number of outcomes.
    13	
    14	These are formalization-only auxiliary results for the compression and rounding
    15	argument preceding the polynomial-support argument in `lem:qld-4-7`. They do not
    16	construct the global polynomial-pair measurement.
    17	
    18	## References
    19

    22	  in the proof of `lem:qld-4-7`
    23	- `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:389-401`,
    24	  `fact:triangle-for-simeq` and `fact:data-processing`
    25	- Issue #278
    26	- `audits/2026-09-06_rounding_transport.md`
    27	-/

    90	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    91	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    92	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)

   132	/-- Formalization-only transport of the rounding supplied by `lem:ortho`.
   133	The projective measurement is chosen before the question distribution, outcome
   134	maps, comparison measurements, and comparison error. The unit-state and
   135	probability hypotheses give total mass one; only `δ ≥ 0` is required of the
   136	rounding error, and no upper range bound on either error is used. This supports

   139	    {ιA ιB α : Type*}
   140	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   141	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   142	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   143	    (A : Measurement α ιA) (B : Measurement α ιB) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)

   145	      (fun _ a => heteroKron (A.effect a) 1)
   146	      (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (B.effect a)) ψ ≤ δ) :

   161	            δ + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   162	              2 * Real.sqrt (δ + η) := by

   164	    projective_rounding_with_explicit_constant ψ hψ A B δ hδ hcons

   190	/-- Tensor-factor exchange intertwines the two Kronecker-product actions. -/
   191	private theorem applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_prodComm {ιA ιB : Type*}
   192	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]

   240	theorem opFamilyDistSq_left_prodComm {X α ιA ιB : Type*}
   241	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   242	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ιB)

   251	
   252	/-- Formalization-only Bob-side form of projective rounding and consistency

   256	theorem projective_rounding_preserves_postprocessed_consistency_right
   257	    {ιA ιB α : Type*}
   258	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   259	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   260	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)

   266	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   267	        (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (P.effect a))
   268	        (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (B.effect a)) ψ ≤
   269	          220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∧

   274	          (fun x b => heteroKron ((N x).effect b) 1)
   275	          (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤ η →

   278	          (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((P.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤
   279	            δ + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   280	              2 * Real.sqrt (δ + η) := by
   281	  have hψ' : ‖reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) ψ‖ = 1 := by
   282	    rw [reindexState_norm_eq, hψ]
   283	  have hcons' : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   284	      (fun _ a => heteroKron (B.effect a) 1)
   285	      (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (A.effect a))
   286	      (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) ψ) ≤ δ := by
   287	    rwa [consistencyDefect_prodComm]

   289	    projective_rounding_preserves_postprocessed_consistency_left
   290	      (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) ψ) hψ' B A δ hδ hcons'

     3	/-! # Ground-coordinate compression of finite measurements
     4	
     5	For a distinguished ancilla coordinate `k₀`, `groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M`
     6	has effects `M.effect a (i, k₀) (j, k₀)`. Positivity and completeness descend
     7	to this principal submatrix. Compression commutes with finite outcome
     8	postprocessing and preserves bipartite consistency exactly on `padState`.
     9	The two players' spaces and their ancilla spaces may all be different.
    10	
    11	These are Lean-only auxiliaries for the two Naimark steps in the proof of
    12	`lem:qld-4-7`, tracked by issue #277. They allow measurements on the enlarged
    13	spaces to be compared on the original spaces, including after polynomial
    14	evaluation. Compression does not in general preserve projectivity; obtaining
    15	projective measurements on the original spaces requires a separate rounding
    16	argument. No statement of `lem:qld-4-7` is formalized here.
    17	
    18	## References
    19	
    20	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1278-1288`,
    21	  the two Naimark steps in the proof of `lem:qld-4-7`.
    22	* `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`,
    23	  `def:consistency`.
    24	-/

    29	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum
    30	
    31	noncomputable section
    32	
    33	section Measurement

    35	variable {α β I K : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    36	  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    37	
    38	/-- Compress every effect of a finite POVM to the coordinate `k₀` of its
    39	ancilla. This is the POVM with effects `J† M_a J`, where `J` inserts `k₀`.
    40	Positivity follows from `Matrix.PosSemidef.submatrix`, and completeness from
    41	the injectivity of the coordinate inclusion. -/
    42	def groundCompressMeasurement (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) :
    43	    Quantum.Measurement α I :=
    44	  Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    45	    (fun a => (M.effect a).submatrix (fun i => (i, k₀)) (fun i => (i, k₀)))
    46	    (fun a => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    47	      ((Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (M.pos a)).submatrix _)) <| by
    48	    ext i j
    49	    simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using
    50	      congrArg (fun T : Op (I × K) => T (i, k₀) (j, k₀)) M.sum_eq_one

    53	@[simp] theorem ground_compress_measurement_effect
    54	    (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (a : α) (i j : I) :
    55	    (groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M).effect a i j =
    56	      M.effect a (i, k₀) (j, k₀) := rfl
    57

    59	of outcomes, since taking a submatrix commutes with each fiber sum. -/

    61	    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    62	    (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (f : α → β) :
    63	    groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (M.postprocess f) =
    64	      (groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M).postprocess f := by
    65	  apply Quantum.Measurement.ext
    66	  intro b
    67	  ext i j
    68	  simp only [ground_compress_measurement_effect, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,

    80	/-- Every bipartite outcome correlation on the independently padded state

    82	Neither normalization nor equality of the player spaces is required. -/
    83	theorem vector_qform_ground_compress_measurement
    84	    (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
    85	    (A : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (B : Quantum.Measurement β (J × L))

   107	  apply avgOver_congr
   108	  intro x
   109	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   110	  intro a _
   111	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   112	  intro b _

   115	  · simp only [heteroKron_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
   116	    exact vector_qform_ground_compress_measurement k₀ l₀ ψ (A x) (B x) a b
   117	
   118	/-- A consistency bound holds on the independently padded state if and only
   119	if the same bound holds for the compressed measurements on the original state. -/
   120	theorem is_consistent_within_ground_compress_measurement_iff [DecidableEq α]
   121	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   122	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
   123	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement α (J × L)) (δ : ℝ) :
   124	    IsConsistentWithin μ
   125	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   126	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) δ ↔
   127	      IsConsistentWithin μ
   128	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (A x)).effect a) 1)
   129	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).effect a)) ψ δ := by

   138	    {γ : Type*} [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
   139	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   140	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
   141	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement β (J × L)) (f : X → α → γ) (g : X → β → γ) :
   142	    consistencyDefect μ
   143	        (fun x c => heteroKron (((A x).postprocess (f x)).effect c) 1)
   144	        (fun x c => heteroKron 1 (((B x).postprocess (g x)).effect c))
   145	        (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) =
   146	      consistencyDefect μ
   147	        (fun x c => heteroKron

   150	          (((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).postprocess (g x)).effect c)) ψ := by
   151	  simpa only [ground_compress_measurement_postprocess] using
   152	    consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement μ k₀ l₀ ψ

   162	    groundCompressMeasurement none (dilatedMeasurement a₀ M) = M := by
   163	  apply Quantum.Measurement.ext
   164	  intro a
   165	  ext i j
   166	  exact dilatedMeasurement_compression a₀ a M i j

blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:1053:	The linked declaration states the theorem above, over an arbitrary strategy of the Magic Square game with the two consistency defects bounded by $\delta$, and it is proved. The formal proof splits at $\sqrt\eps + \sqrt\delta \ge 1$, where the seven conclusions hold for the trivial witness; in the complementary regime the witness is the tensor of the two players' two-qubit controlled-swap embeddings, composed with the dilation embedding. Each of those embeddings composes two one-qubit controlled swaps, one for each of two logical pairs of that player's $\pm 1$ reflections on the dilated state, and the two players' pairs are not chosen symmetrically. Bob's are his variable reflections at the cells of $\mathsf{Variable}_1$ and $\mathsf{Variable}_5$ and at those of $\mathsf{Variable}_2$ and $\mathsf{Variable}_4$. Alice's first pair is her variable reflections at the cells of $\mathsf{Variable}_1$ and $\mathsf{Variable}_5$, but her second is her \emph{constraint} reflections at the cells of $\mathsf{Variable}_2$ and $\mathsf{Variable}_4$, read from the first and from the second row. That asymmetry is forced by the hypothesis: \eqref{eq:ms-rigidity-consistency} compares the two players only at $\mathsf{Variable}_1$ and $\mathsf{Variable}_5$, so their $\mathsf{Variable}_2$ and $\mathsf{Variable}_4$ measurements cannot be compared, whereas Alice's constraint reflections at those two cells are compared with Bob's variable reflections there by a question pair that the distribution does sample. Item~1 is the joint state estimate on the dilation, which needs the approximate anticommutation of both of Alice's pairs, the cross-player agreement of all four pairs of corresponding reflections, and the approximate commutation of the two pairs of each player; the anticommutation of the second pair comes from a second closed path through the grid, which crosses the exceptional third column once and therefore returns the reversed product with the opposite sign. The bit-measurement relations come from the transport of the first logical pair through those embeddings, exactly for the phase observable and up to the anticommutator defect of that pair for the shift observable; the anticommutation consequences come from the solution-group computation on the dilation, products composing under conjugation by an isometry. Every conclusion is then moved from the dilated strategy to the original one by the leakage bounds of the dilation, with an explicit universal constant, which the formalization takes to be $2 \cdot 10^{12}$. The specialization to symmetric consistent strategies ($\delta = 0$) is stated as a separate declaration derived from it.

    31	    {P : AdmissibleParams} {ε : ℝ} (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
    32	    (Q : (side : PlayerSide) → (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) →
    33	      (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) →
    34	      Quantum.Measurement (PauliScalar P × PauliScalar P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side))
    35	    (hQ : ∀ side x z, Measurement.IsProjective (Q side x z)) :
    36	    ∃ δ : ℝ, ∃ points : CombinedPointsWitness S δ, points.Q = Q := by
    37	  let law := uniformDistribution
    38	    ((Fin P.m → PauliScalar P) × (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
    39	  let selfError (p : Placement × Placement) := opFamilyDistSq law
    40	    (fun xz ab => S.place p.1 ((Q p.1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
    41	    (fun xz ab => S.place p.2 ((Q p.2.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab)) S.psiHat
    42	  let xzError (p : Placement × Placement) := opFamilyDistSq law
    43	    (fun xz ab => S.place p.1 ((Q p.1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
    44	    (fun xz ab => S.place p.2
    45	      ((S.pointMeasExp p.2.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1 *
    46	        (S.pointMeasExp p.2.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2)) S.psiHat
    47	  let zxError (p : Placement × Placement) := opFamilyDistSq law
    48	    (fun xz ab => S.place p.1 ((Q p.1.side xz.1 xz.2).effect ab))
    49	    (fun xz ab => S.place p.2
    50	      ((S.pointMeasExp p.2.side .Z xz.2).effect ab.2 *
    51	        (S.pointMeasExp p.2.side .X xz.1).effect ab.1)) S.psiHat
    52	  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := Finite.bddAbove_range
    53	    (fun p => max (selfError p) (max (xzError p) (zxError p)))
    54	  have hbound (p : Placement × Placement) := hδ (Set.mem_range_self p)

    56	  · intro p1 p2 _
    57	    exact (le_max_left _ _).trans (hbound (p1, p2))
    58	  · intro p1 p2 _
    59	    exact ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)).trans (hbound (p1, p2))
    60	  · intro p1 p2 _
    61	    exact ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)).trans (hbound (p1, p2))

     5	/-! # Encoding-supported Pauli reference measurements
     6	
     7	The reference measurement measures the strategy's Pauli answer and an independent
     8	ideal Pauli answer, then returns the bounded encoding of their sum. Its effects
     9	vanish outside the encoding image. Evaluation of its polynomial outcome is the
    10	convolution of the evaluated strategy measurement and the ideal point projectors.
    11	
    12	These are internal auxiliary constructions for blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`
    13	and `lem:qld-nonencoding-mass-bound`, not the quantitative support estimate. No
    14	winning premise or global polynomial-pair witness is used or constructed here.
    15	
    16	## References
    17	
    18	The encoding is paper `eq:low-degree-encoding-definition` in
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/04_preliminaries.tex:882-897`. The convolution is the Pauli
    20	answer replacement of the expanded point measurement at
    21	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:383-418`.
    22	The corrected use in `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` is recorded in blueprint
    23	`eq:qld-nonencoding-mass` and `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_decoding-identity.tex`.

    29	
    30	open MIPStarRE.Quantum

    32	variable {params : AdmissibleParams} {error : ℝ}
    33	
    34	/-- The ideal Pauli basis measurement on the ancillary register, bundled using
    35	positivity and completeness of the existing Pauli projectors. -/
    36	noncomputable def pauliRegisterMeas (basis : PauliKind) :
    37	    Measurement (PauliRegister params) (PauliRegister params) :=
    38	  Measurement.ofSumEqOne (pauliProj basis)
    39	    (fun answer => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (posSemidef_pauliProj basis answer))
    40	    (sum_pauliProj_eq_one basis)
    41	
    42	/-- Every bounded encoding lies in the full-field decoder's encoding image. -/
    43	@[simp] theorem isEncoding_encodingPoly (answer : PauliRegister params) :
    44	    IsEncoding (encodingPoly answer) := by
    45	  unfold IsEncoding
    46	  rw [decodeFq_lowDegreeEncoding]
    47	  rfl
    48	
    49	namespace ProjectiveSetting
    50	
    51	/-- Measure the strategy Pauli answer and the ancillary ideal Pauli answer and
    52	return the encoding of their sum. This complete POVM is the internal reference
    53	measurement underlying blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`; it is not the global
    54	polynomial measurement whose existence is required in `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
    55	noncomputable def encodingPauliMeas (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
    56	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) :
    57	    Measurement (Poly params) (setting.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
    58	  (tensorMeasurement (setting.pauliMeas side basis) (pauliRegisterMeas basis)).postprocess
    59	    fun answers => encodingPoly (answers.1 + answers.2)

    62	the specified polynomial representative. -/
    63	theorem encodingPauliMeas_effect (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
    64	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) (poly : Poly params) :
    65	    (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).effect poly =
    66	      ∑ answers ∈ Finset.univ.filter
    67	          (fun answers : PauliRegister params × PauliRegister params =>
    68	            encodingPoly (answers.1 + answers.2) = poly),
    69	        heteroKron ((setting.pauliMeas side basis).effect answers.1)
    70	          (pauliProj basis answers.2) :=
    71	  rfl
    72

    75	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) (poly : Poly params) :
    76	    0 ≤ (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).effect poly :=
    77	  (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).pos poly
    78

    80	theorem sum_encodingPauliMeas_effect_eq_one (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error)
    81	    (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind) :
    82	    ∑ poly, (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).effect poly = 1 :=
    83	  (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).sum_eq_one

    88	    (setting : ProjectiveSetting params error) (side : PlayerSide) (basis : PauliKind)

    90	    (setting.encodingPauliMeas side basis).effect poly = 0 := by

   135	probability hypotheses give total mass one; only `δ ≥ 0` is required of the
   136	rounding error, and no upper range bound on either error is used. This supports
   137	the compression step in `lem:qld-4-7`, not its global-witness conclusion. -/
   138	theorem projective_rounding_preserves_postprocessed_consistency_left
   139	    {ιA ιB α : Type*}
   140	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   141	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   142	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   143	    (A : Measurement α ιA) (B : Measurement α ιB) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
   144	    (hcons : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   145	      (fun _ a => heteroKron (A.effect a) 1)
   146	      (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (B.effect a)) ψ ≤ δ) :
   147	    ∃ P : Measurement α ιA, Measurement.IsProjective P ∧
   148	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   149	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (P.effect a) 1)
   150	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (A.effect a) 1) ψ ≤
   151	          220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∧
   152	      ∀ {X β : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   153	        (μ : Distribution X), μ.IsProbability → ∀ (f : X → α → β)
   154	        (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (η : ℝ),
   155	        consistencyDefect μ
   156	          (fun x b => heteroKron ((A.postprocess (f x)).effect b) 1)
   157	          (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect b)) ψ ≤ η →
   158	        consistencyDefect μ
   159	          (fun x b => heteroKron ((P.postprocess (f x)).effect b) 1)
   160	          (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect b)) ψ ≤
   161	            δ + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   162	              2 * Real.sqrt (δ + η) := by
   163	  obtain ⟨P, hP, hdist⟩ :=
   164	    projective_rounding_with_explicit_constant ψ hψ A B δ hδ hcons
   165	  refine ⟨P, hP, hdist, ?_⟩
   166	  intro X β _ _ _ _ μ hμ f N η hAN
   167	  have hPB := rounding_consistency_le ψ hψ P A B δ _ hcons hdist
   168	  have hABf : consistencyDefect μ
   169	      (fun x b => heteroKron ((A.postprocess (f x)).effect b) 1)
   170	      (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤ δ := by
   171	    refine (consistencyDefect_postprocess_question_le μ
   172	      (fun _ => A) (fun _ => B) ψ f).trans ?_
   173	    rw [consistencyDefect_const_eq μ hμ]
   174	    exact hcons
   175	  have hPBf : consistencyDefect μ
   176	      (fun x b => heteroKron ((P.postprocess (f x)).effect b) 1)
   177	      (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤
   178	        δ + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
   179	    refine (consistencyDefect_postprocess_question_le μ
   180	      (fun _ => P) (fun _ => B) ψ f).trans ?_
   181	    rw [consistencyDefect_const_eq μ hμ]
   182	    exact hPB
   183	  simpa only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
   184	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] using consistencyDefect_trans_le μ
   185	    (fun x => leftPlacedMeasurement (P.postprocess (f x)))
   186	    (fun x => rightPlacedMeasurement (B.postprocess (f x)))
   187	    (fun x => leftPlacedMeasurement (A.postprocess (f x)))
   188	    (fun x => rightPlacedMeasurement (N x)) ψ _ δ η hμ hψ hPBf hABf hAN

   190	/-- Tensor-factor exchange intertwines the two Kronecker-product actions. -/
   191	private theorem applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_prodComm {ιA ιB : Type*}
   192	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   193	    (A : Op ιA) (B : Op ιB) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   194	    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron B A) (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) ψ) =
   195	      reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron A B) ψ) := by
   196	  have hop : heteroKron B A =
   197	      (heteroKron A B).submatrix (Equiv.prodComm ιB ιA) (Equiv.prodComm ιB ιA) := by
   198	    ext i j
   199	    exact mul_comm _ _
   200	  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ιB × ιA) ℂ).injective
   201	  change heteroKron B A *ᵥ (ψ.ofLp ∘ (Equiv.prodComm ιB ιA)) =
   202	    (heteroKron A B *ᵥ ψ.ofLp) ∘ (Equiv.prodComm ιB ιA)
   203	  rw [hop, Matrix.submatrix_mulVec_equiv _ _ _ (Equiv.prodComm ιB ιA)]
   204	  rfl

   206	private theorem stateQForm_heteroKron_prodComm {ιA ιB : Type*}
   207	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]

   209	    stateQForm (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) ψ) (heteroKron B A) =

   211	  unfold stateQForm
   212	  rw [applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_prodComm]
   213	  exact congrArg Complex.re
   214	    ((LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℂ ℂ (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB)).inner_map_map

   217	/-- Formalization-only factor-exchange identity for `lem:ortho` and its

   220	theorem consistencyDefect_prodComm {X α ιA ιB : Type*}

   222	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]

   230	  simp_rw [consistency_term_eq_stateQForm, placed_product_stateQForm_eq,

   233	  intro x
   234	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

   237	/-- Formalization-only distance identity for the Bob-side rounding in
   238	`lem:ortho`: left placement on the exchanged state is right placement on the
   239	original state. The two local coordinate types may be different. -/
   240	theorem opFamilyDistSq_left_prodComm {X α ιA ιB : Type*}
   241	    [Fintype α] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   242	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → α → Op ιB)
   243	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   244	    opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => heteroKron (A x a) 1)

   247	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (B x a)) ψ := by

   249	  simp_rw [← heteroKron_sub_left, applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_prodComm,

   251	
   252	/-- Formalization-only Bob-side form of projective rounding and consistency
   253	transport for `lem:qld-4-7`. It follows by explicitly exchanging the tensor
   254	factors and applying the Alice-side theorem to the exchanged state. The error
   255	and normalization hypotheses are exactly those of the Alice-side form. -/
   256	theorem projective_rounding_preserves_postprocessed_consistency_right
   257	    {ιA ιB α : Type*}
   258	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   259	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   260	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   261	    (A : Measurement α ιA) (B : Measurement α ιB) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
   262	    (hcons : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   263	      (fun _ a => heteroKron (A.effect a) 1)
   264	      (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (B.effect a)) ψ ≤ δ) :
   265	    ∃ P : Measurement α ιB, Measurement.IsProjective P ∧
   266	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)

   268	        (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (B.effect a)) ψ ≤
   269	          220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∧
   270	      ∀ {X β : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   271	        (μ : Distribution X), μ.IsProbability → ∀ (f : X → α → β)
   272	        (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (η : ℝ),
   273	        consistencyDefect μ
   274	          (fun x b => heteroKron ((N x).effect b) 1)
   275	          (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤ η →
   276	        consistencyDefect μ
   277	          (fun x b => heteroKron ((N x).effect b) 1)
   278	          (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((P.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤
   279	            δ + Real.sqrt (220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) +
   280	              2 * Real.sqrt (δ + η) := by
   281	  have hψ' : ‖reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) ψ‖ = 1 := by
   282	    rw [reindexState_norm_eq, hψ]
   283	  have hcons' : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   284	      (fun _ a => heteroKron (B.effect a) 1)
   285	      (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (A.effect a))
   286	      (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) ψ) ≤ δ := by
   287	    rwa [consistencyDefect_prodComm]
   288	  obtain ⟨P, hP, hdist, htransport⟩ :=
   289	    projective_rounding_preserves_postprocessed_consistency_left
   290	      (reindexState (Equiv.prodComm ιA ιB) ψ) hψ' B A δ hδ hcons'
   291	  rw [opFamilyDistSq_left_prodComm] at hdist
   292	  refine ⟨P, hP, hdist, ?_⟩

   294	  have hNB' : consistencyDefect μ
   295	      (fun x b => heteroKron ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b) 1)

   298	    rwa [consistencyDefect_prodComm]

   300	  rwa [consistencyDefect_prodComm] at hout
   301	
   302	/-- Formalization-only simultaneous rounding and transport for the compression
   303	step of `lem:qld-4-7`. A single pair of complete projective measurements on the
   304	original heterogeneous spaces satisfies the distance bounds and both consistency
   305	estimates for every finite question type, probability distribution, and
   306	question-dependent outcome map. Each comparison family requires only its own
   307	consistency bound against the corresponding unrounded POVM. The hypotheses are
   308	`‖ψ‖ = 1`, `δ ≥ 0`, and the original cross-player consistency bound; no range
   309	restriction on the comparison error or outcome-cardinality factor is imposed. -/
   310	theorem projective_rounding_preserves_postprocessed_consistency
   311	    {ιA ιB α : Type*}
   312	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   313	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   314	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   315	    (A : Measurement α ιA) (B : Measurement α ιB) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
   316	    (hcons : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   317	      (fun _ a => heteroKron (A.effect a) 1)
   318	      (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (B.effect a)) ψ ≤ δ) :
   319	    ∃ PA : Measurement α ιA, ∃ PB : Measurement α ιB,
   320	      Measurement.IsProjective PA ∧ Measurement.IsProjective PB ∧
   321	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   322	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (PA.effect a) 1)
   323	        (fun _ a => heteroKron (A.effect a) 1) ψ ≤
   324	          220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∧
   325	      opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   326	        (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (PB.effect a))
   327	        (fun _ a => heteroKron 1 (B.effect a)) ψ ≤
   328	          220 * Real.rpow δ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∧
   329	      ∀ {X β : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
   330	        (μ : Distribution X), μ.IsProbability → ∀ (f : X → α → β),
   331	        (∀ (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (η : ℝ),
   332	          consistencyDefect μ
   333	            (fun x b => heteroKron ((A.postprocess (f x)).effect b) 1)
   334	            (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((N x).effect b)) ψ ≤ η →
   335	          consistencyDefect μ
   336	            (fun x b => heteroKron ((PA.postprocess (f x)).effect b) 1)

   340	        (∀ (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (η : ℝ),
   341	          consistencyDefect μ
   342	            (fun x b => heteroKron ((N x).effect b) 1)
   343	            (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤ η →

   349	  obtain ⟨PA, hPA, hAdist, hAtransport⟩ :=

     3	/-! # Ground-coordinate compression of finite measurements
     4	
     5	For a distinguished ancilla coordinate `k₀`, `groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M`
     6	has effects `M.effect a (i, k₀) (j, k₀)`. Positivity and completeness descend
     7	to this principal submatrix. Compression commutes with finite outcome
     8	postprocessing and preserves bipartite consistency exactly on `padState`.
     9	The two players' spaces and their ancilla spaces may all be different.
    10	
    11	These are Lean-only auxiliaries for the two Naimark steps in the proof of
    12	`lem:qld-4-7`, tracked by issue #277. They allow measurements on the enlarged
    13	spaces to be compared on the original spaces, including after polynomial
    14	evaluation. Compression does not in general preserve projectivity; obtaining
    15	projective measurements on the original spaces requires a separate rounding
    16	argument. No statement of `lem:qld-4-7` is formalized here.
    17	
    18	## References
    19	
    20	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1278-1288`,
    21	  the two Naimark steps in the proof of `lem:qld-4-7`.
    22	* `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:232-248`,
    23	  `def:consistency`.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    27	
    28	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    29	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum

    33	section Measurement
    34	
    35	variable {α β I K : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    36	  [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    37	
    38	/-- Compress every effect of a finite POVM to the coordinate `k₀` of its
    39	ancilla. This is the POVM with effects `J† M_a J`, where `J` inserts `k₀`.
    40	Positivity follows from `Matrix.PosSemidef.submatrix`, and completeness from
    41	the injectivity of the coordinate inclusion. -/
    42	def groundCompressMeasurement (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) :
    43	    Quantum.Measurement α I :=
    44	  Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    45	    (fun a => (M.effect a).submatrix (fun i => (i, k₀)) (fun i => (i, k₀)))
    46	    (fun a => Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    47	      ((Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (M.pos a)).submatrix _)) <| by
    48	    ext i j
    49	    simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using
    50	      congrArg (fun T : Op (I × K) => T (i, k₀) (j, k₀)) M.sum_eq_one
    51	
    52	/-- The compressed effect is the principal submatrix at `k₀`. -/
    53	@[simp] theorem ground_compress_measurement_effect
    54	    (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (a : α) (i j : I) :
    55	    (groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M).effect a i j =
    56	      M.effect a (i, k₀) (j, k₀) := rfl
    57	
    58	/-- Ground-coordinate compression commutes with arbitrary finite relabeling
    59	of outcomes, since taking a submatrix commutes with each fiber sum. -/
    60	@[simp] theorem ground_compress_measurement_postprocess
    61	    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    62	    (k₀ : K) (M : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (f : α → β) :
    63	    groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (M.postprocess f) =
    64	      (groundCompressMeasurement k₀ M).postprocess f := by
    65	  apply Quantum.Measurement.ext
    66	  intro b
    67	  ext i j
    68	  simp only [ground_compress_measurement_effect, Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    69	    Matrix.sum_apply]
    70	
    71	end Measurement

    75	variable {X α β I J K L : Type*}
    76	  [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α] [Fintype β]

    78	  [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L]

    80	/-- Every bipartite outcome correlation on the independently padded state
    81	equals the correlation of the compressed POVMs on the original state.
    82	Neither normalization nor equality of the player spaces is required. -/
    83	theorem vector_qform_ground_compress_measurement
    84	    (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
    85	    (A : Quantum.Measurement α (I × K)) (B : Quantum.Measurement β (J × L))
    86	    (a : α) (b : β) :
    87	    vectorQForm (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect b)) =
    88	      vectorQForm ψ (heteroKron
    89	        ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ A).effect a)
    90	        ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ B).effect b)) := by
    91	  exact stateQForm_padState k₀ l₀ ψ _ _ _ _ (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl)

    93	/-- The averaged off-diagonal consistency defect is exactly preserved by
    94	ground-coordinate compression on independently padded bipartite states.
    95	This applies to any finite question distribution and any pair of POVM families. -/
    96	theorem consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement [DecidableEq α]
    97	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
    98	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
    99	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement α (J × L)) :
   100	    consistencyDefect μ
   101	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   102	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) =
   103	      consistencyDefect μ
   104	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (A x)).effect a) 1)
   105	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).effect a)) ψ := by
   106	  unfold consistencyDefect
   107	  apply avgOver_congr
   108	  intro x
   109	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   110	  intro a _
   111	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   112	  intro b _
   113	  split_ifs with hab
   114	  · rfl
   115	  · simp only [heteroKron_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
   116	    exact vector_qform_ground_compress_measurement k₀ l₀ ψ (A x) (B x) a b
   117	
   118	/-- A consistency bound holds on the independently padded state if and only
   119	if the same bound holds for the compressed measurements on the original state. -/
   120	theorem is_consistent_within_ground_compress_measurement_iff [DecidableEq α]
   121	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   122	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
   123	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement α (J × L)) (δ : ℝ) :
   124	    IsConsistentWithin μ
   125	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((A x).effect a) 1)
   126	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((B x).effect a)) (padState k₀ l₀ ψ) δ ↔
   127	      IsConsistentWithin μ
   128	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((groundCompressMeasurement k₀ (A x)).effect a) 1)
   129	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((groundCompressMeasurement l₀ (B x)).effect a)) ψ δ := by
   130	  unfold IsConsistentWithin
   131	  rw [consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement]
   132	
   133	/-- Exact consistency preservation also holds after question-dependent
   134	postprocessing. The original outcome types and the two outcome maps may
   135	differ; only the final outcome alphabet is shared. In the application to
   136	`lem:qld-4-7`, these maps include evaluation of the polynomial outcomes. -/
   137	theorem consistency_defect_ground_compress_measurement_postprocess
   138	    {γ : Type*} [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq γ] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
   139	    (μ : Distribution X) (k₀ : K) (l₀ : L) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (I × J))
   140	    (A : X → Quantum.Measurement α (I × K))
   141	    (B : X → Quantum.Measurement β (J × L)) (f : X → α → γ) (g : X → β → γ) :
   142	    consistencyDefect μ
   143	        (fun x c => heteroKron (((A x).postprocess (f x)).effect c) 1)
   144	        (fun x c => heteroKron 1 (((B x).postprocess (g x)).effect c))

     3	/-!
     4	# Completion on a prescribed set of outcomes
     5	
     6	This formalization-only auxiliary constructs a complete measurement supported on
     7	the good outcomes of a finite measurement, by sending every bad outcome to a
     8	specified good outcome. For projective measurements this adds the complementary
     9	projection to the default effect and preserves projectivity. The consistency
    10	estimates charge changes of outcome labels only to the state mass of that
    11	complementary projection, on either of two possibly different player spaces.
    12	
    13	The source-specific estimate on the mass outside the image of the polynomial
    14	combining map is the unimplemented target `global_polynomial_bad_mass_le`,
    15	specified in `audits/2026-09-06_supported-projective-completion.md` under issue #279.
    16	No result here asserts the global polynomial-pair theorem or derives that estimate.
    17	
    18	## References
    19	
    20	* `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1364-1402`,
    21	  the completion step after `eq:qld-sgg-mhat-sandwich` in `lem:qld-4-7`.
    22	* Blueprint `lem:qld-4-7`, whose source theorem remains separate from this auxiliary.
    23	-/

    25	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

    27	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.SupportedCompletion

    33	variable {α β X ι ιA ιB : Type*}
    34	variable [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]

    39	/-- Retain every good outcome and send every other outcome to the specified
    40	good outcome. The default is actual domain data, with its membership proof. -/
    41	def toGood (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    42	    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (a : α) : {a // good a} :=
    43	  if h : good a then ⟨a, h⟩ else a₀
    44	
    45	omit [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] in
    46	@[simp] theorem toGood_coe (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    47	    (a₀ a : {a // good a}) : toGood good a₀ a = a := by
    48	  simp [toGood, a.property]
    49	
    50	/-- The omitted effects. When the measurement is projective, their sum is the
    51	projection complementary to the sum of good effects. -/
    52	noncomputable def badEffect (M : Measurement α ι)
    53	    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : Op ι :=
    54	  ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => ¬ good a), M.effect a
    55	
    56	/-- Complete the restriction to good outcomes by adding all bad effects to
    57	`a₀`. This is an outcome postprocessing of the original complete measurement. -/
    58	noncomputable def complete (M : Measurement α ι)
    59	    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a₀ : {a // good a}) :
    60	    Measurement {a // good a} ι :=
    61	  M.postprocess (toGood good a₀)
    62	
    63	/-- The completion is projective whenever the original measurement is
    64	projective, by projectivity of outcome postprocessing. -/
    65	theorem complete_isProjective (M : Measurement α ι)
    66	    (hM : Measurement.IsProjective M) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
    67	    (a₀ : {a // good a}) : Measurement.IsProjective (complete M good a₀) :=
    68	  SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective M hM (toGood good a₀)
    69	
    70	omit [DecidableEq α] in
    71	/-- The bad effect is precisely the complement of the restricted total. -/
    72	theorem badEffect_eq_one_sub (M : Measurement α ι)
    73	    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] :
    74	    badEffect M good = 1 - ∑ a : {a // good a}, M.effect a := by
    75	  have hsplit := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype good M.effect
    76	  have hbad : badEffect M good = ∑ a : {a // ¬ good a}, M.effect a := by
    77	    exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) M.effect
    78	  rw [hbad]
    79	  rw [M.sum_eq_one] at hsplit
    80	  exact eq_sub_of_add_eq' hsplit
    81	
    82	omit [DecidableEq α] in
    83	/-- The sum of the omitted effects is positive semidefinite. -/
    84	theorem badEffect_nonneg (M : Measurement α ι)
    85	    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : 0 ≤ badEffect M good :=
    86	  Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => M.pos a
    87	
    88	/-- The submeasurement obtained by retaining only the good outcomes. -/
    89	noncomputable def restrict (M : Measurement α ι)
    90	    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] : Submeasurement {a // good a} ι where
    91	  effect a := M.effect a
    92	  pos a := M.pos a
    93	  sum_le_one := by
    94	    have h := badEffect_nonneg M good
    95	    rw [badEffect_eq_one_sub] at h
    96	    exact sub_nonneg.mp h

    98	/-- The bad effect is itself a projection: it is one effect of the binary
    99	postprocessing recording whether an outcome is bad. -/
   100	theorem badEffect_isStarProjection (M : Measurement α ι)
   101	    (hM : Measurement.IsProjective M) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] :
   102	    IsStarProjection (badEffect M good) := by
   103	  have h := SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective M hM
   104	    (fun a => decide (¬ good a)) true
   105	  change IsStarProjection (∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter
   106	    (fun a => decide (¬ good a) = true), M.effect a) at h
   107	  simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq, badEffect] using h
   108	
   109	/-- The completed default effect absorbs exactly the omitted projection;
   110	all other good effects are retained. -/
   111	theorem complete_effect (M : Measurement α ι)
   112	    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a₀ a : {a // good a}) :
   113	    (complete M good a₀).effect a =
   114	      M.effect a + if a = a₀ then badEffect M good else 0 := by
   115	  classical
   116	  rw [complete, Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_filter]
   117	  have hterm (b : α) :
   118	      (if toGood good a₀ b = a then M.effect b else 0) =
   119	        (if b = a.val then M.effect b else 0) +
   120	          if a = a₀ then (if ¬ good b then M.effect b else 0) else 0 := by
   121	    by_cases hb : good b
   122	    · have heq : toGood good a₀ b = a ↔ b = a.val := by
   123	        simp [toGood, hb, Subtype.ext_iff]
   124	      simp [heq, hb]
   125	    · have hba : b ≠ a.val := by
   126	        rintro rfl
   127	        exact hb a.property
   128	      simp [toGood, hb, hba, eq_comm]
   129	  simp_rw [hterm]
   130	  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   131	  simp [badEffect, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_ite_irrel]
   132	
   133	/-- Relabeling the completed measurement adds the bad effect to exactly the
   134	label of the chosen default outcome, relative to the relabeled restriction. -/
   135	theorem complete_postprocess_effect (M : Measurement α ι)
   136	    (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good] (a₀ : {a // good a})
   137	    (g : {a // good a} → β) (b : β) :
   138	    ((complete M good a₀).postprocess g).effect b =
   139	      ((restrict M good).postprocess g).effect b +
   140	        if b = g a₀ then badEffect M good else 0 := by
   141	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect]
   142	  simp_rw [complete_effect]
   143	  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   144	  congr 1
   145	  simp [eq_comm]

   147	private theorem postprocess_overlap (M : Measurement α ι) (N : Measurement β ι)
   148	    (f : α → β) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   149	    (∑ b, stateQForm ψ ((M.postprocess f).effect b * N.effect b)) =
   150	      ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * N.effect (f a)) := by
   151	  simp only [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect, Finset.sum_mul,
   152	    stateQForm_finset_sum]
   153	  calc
   154	    (∑ b, ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
   155	        stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * N.effect b)) =
   156	      ∑ b, ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b),
   157	        stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * N.effect (f a)) := by
   158	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   159	          intro b _
   160	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   161	          intro a ha
   162	          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
   163	    _ = _ := Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ f _

   165	private theorem postprocess_defect (μ : Distribution X) (M : Measurement α ι)
   166	    (N : X → Measurement β ι) (f : X → α → β) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   167	    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => (M.postprocess (f x)).effect a)

   169	      avgOver μ (fun x => ‖ψ‖ ^ 2 -
   170	        ∑ a, stateQForm ψ (M.effect a * (N x).effect (f x a))) := by
   171	  unfold consistencyDefect
   172	  simp_rw [consistency_term_eq_stateQForm, point_defect_eq, postprocess_overlap]
   173	
   174	private theorem leftPlaced_postprocess (M : Measurement α ιA) (f : α → β) :
   175	    leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) (M.postprocess f) =
   245	        Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => hterm a
   246	      _ = _ := (Finset.sum_filter _ _).symm
   247	  rw [← avgOver_sub]
   248	  calc
   249	    _ ≤ avgOver μ (fun x => |(c - ∑ a, u x a) - (c - ∑ a, v x a)|) := by

   260	/-- Relabelings that agree on good outcomes change Alice-first cross-player
   261	consistency by at most Alice's bad-outcome state mass. The spaces may differ,
   262	the other measurement need not be projective, and the state may be unnormalized.
   263	This auxiliary isolates the quantitative content of the source completion step. -/
   264	theorem abs_postprocess_consistency_left_sub_le
   265	    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιA)
   266	    (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
   267	    (f g : X → α → β) (hfg : ∀ x a, good a → f x a = g x a)

   269	    |consistencyDefect μ

   275	      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (badEffect M good) (1 : Op ιB)) := by

   277	  simp only [badEffect, heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum]

   289	/-- Relabelings that agree on good outcomes change Bob-first cross-player
   290	consistency by at most Bob's bad-outcome state mass. The completed measurement
   291	is the first consistency argument, although it acts on the right tensor factor;
   292	this is the orientation of the Bob conclusion of `lem:qld-4-7`. -/
   293	theorem abs_postprocess_consistency_right_sub_le
   294	    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιB)
   295	    (N : X → Measurement β ιA) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]

   298	    |consistencyDefect μ
   299	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (f x)).effect a))
   300	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ -
   301	      consistencyDefect μ
   302	        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 ((M.postprocess (g x)).effect a))
   303	        (fun x a => heteroKron ((N x).effect a) 1) ψ| ≤
   304	      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (badEffect M good)) := by
   305	  rw [right_postprocess_defect, right_postprocess_defect]
   306	  simp only [badEffect, heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   307	  have hbound (x : X) (a : α) (b : β) :

   309	        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron ((N x).effect b) (M.effect a)) ≤

   313	        (kronecker_mono_left (measurement_effect_le_one (N x) b) (M.pos a)) ψ⟩
   314	  exact abs_avg_sum_change_le μ hμ good _ _ _
   315	    (fun x a => hbound x a (f x a)) (fun x a => hbound x a (g x a))
   316	    (fun x a ha => by rw [hfg x a ha]) _

   322	theorem abs_complete_consistency_left_sub_le
   323	    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιA)
   324	    (N : X → Measurement β ιB) (good : α → Prop) [DecidablePred good]
   325	    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (f : X → α → β) (g : X → {a // good a} → β)

   342	theorem abs_complete_consistency_right_sub_le
   343	    (μ : Distribution X) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (M : Measurement α ιB)

   345	    (a₀ : {a // good a}) (f : X → α → β) (g : X → {a // good a} → β)
   346	    (hgf : ∀ x a, g x a = f x a) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :

   353	      stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (badEffect M good)) := by

   359	/-- Adding one fixed operator at a question-dependent outcome changes the
   360	defect by its total state mass minus the overlap at that outcome. -/
   361	private theorem add_at_outcome_defect (μ : Distribution X)
   362	    (A : X → β → Op ι) (N : X → Measurement β ι)
   363	    (R : Op ι) (k : X → β) (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   364	    consistencyDefect μ (fun x a => A x a + if a = k x then R else 0)
   365	        (fun x a => (N x).effect a) ψ =
   366	      consistencyDefect μ A (fun x a => (N x).effect a) ψ +
   367	        avgOver μ (fun x => stateQForm ψ R - stateQForm ψ (R * (N x).effect (k x))) := by
   368	  unfold consistencyDefect
   369	  simp_rw [consistency_term_eq_stateQForm]
   370	  have hpoint (x : X) :
   371	      (∑ a, ∑ b, if a = b then 0 else
   372	        stateQForm ψ ((A x a + if a = k x then R else 0) * (N x).effect b)) =
   373	      (∑ a, ∑ b, if a = b then 0 else stateQForm ψ (A x a * (N x).effect b)) +
   374	        (stateQForm ψ R - stateQForm ψ (R * (N x).effect (k x))) := by
   375	    have hterm (a b : β) :
   376	        (if a = b then 0 else
   377	          stateQForm ψ ((A x a + if a = k x then R else 0) * (N x).effect b)) =
   378	        (if a = b then 0 else stateQForm ψ (A x a * (N x).effect b)) +
   379	          if a = k x then
   380	            (if a = b then 0 else stateQForm ψ (R * (N x).effect b)) else 0 := by
   381	      by_cases hab : a = b
   382	      · simp only [hab, if_true, ite_self, add_zero]
   383	      · simp only [hab, if_false]
   384	        by_cases ha : a = k x <;> simp [ha, add_mul, stateQForm_add]
   385	    simp_rw [hterm, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   386	    congr 1
   387	    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   388	    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
   389	    rw [Finset.sum_ite]
   390	    simp only [Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
   391	    rw [show Finset.univ.filter (fun b => ¬ k x = b) = Finset.univ.erase (k x) by
   392	      ext b
   393	      simp [ne_comm]]
   394	    rw [Finset.sum_erase_eq_sub (Finset.mem_univ _),
   395	      ← stateQForm_finset_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
   396	      (N x).sum_eq_one, mul_one]
   397	  simp_rw [hpoint]
